summary: Iteration 4 focused testing of profile edit (name/username/phone), avatar upload via /api/upload, and search by phone — plus UI polish regression (date separators, chat wallpaper, no overflow at 1280 & 390). Backend: 7/7 new iter4 tests PASS; also re-ran full suite 33/34 pass (one pre-existing iter3 test now fails intentionally because server now validates group avatars must be /api/files/ URLs — that was explicitly recommended in iter3 code review and E1 implemented it). Frontend: all iter4 selectors render & behave correctly; profile phone persists; date separators ('Today') show; chat-wallpaper div present; new-chat search by phone fragment '1112222' returns Giulia.

backend_feature_results.profile_edit: GET /api/auth/me returns 'phone' field. PUT /api/auth/profile accepts {name, username, phone}, persists all three (verified via subsequent GET /me). Username uniqueness still returns HTTP 400 with detail 'Username taken'.
backend_feature_results.avatar_upload: POST /api/upload with image/png returns {id, url:/api/files/{id}, is_image:true}. PUT /api/auth/profile {avatar: absolute URL} persists; GET /api/auth/me reflects it; GET /api/files/{id} serves image with image/* content-type.
backend_feature_results.search_by_phone: After setting phone '+39 333 9998877' on Giulia, James GET /api/users/search?q=9998877 returns Giulia. Search by username fragment and by email fragment still return Giulia.
backend_feature_results.server_hardening_bonus: server.py now enforces avatar URL must contain '/api/files/' (prevents hostile external URLs — this was the iter3 code-review recommendation; now implemented at both profile and group-info update paths).

frontend_results.settings_dialog: user-menu-button -> open-settings-item opens dialog. settings-name-input, settings-username-input, settings-phone-input, change-avatar-button all visible. save-profile-button hidden until a field changes, then becomes visible. After save, phone value persists across dialog reopen.
frontend_results.ui_polish: chat-wallpaper div renders in open conversation. 'Today' date-separator chips appear between messages. No horizontal overflow at 1280x900 (sw=cw=1280) or 390x844 (sw=cw=390).
frontend_results.new_chat_phone_search: new-chat-button opens Start a new chat dialog. user-search-input with phone fragment '1112222' returns Giulia Rossi (search-result-<uuid>) with Chat CTA.
frontend_results.regression: Login as giulia & james works; message sent from Giulia increments james' unread count (visible '12' badge on Giulia Rossi item), confirming send + delivery path still functional.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown further (865 lines) — still >700 soft limit; splitting into routers remains desirable.
search_users still passes raw q into $regex without re.escape — a user searching '+39' (contains '+' which is a regex quantifier) will raise an error. Already observed in iter3 review; still unfixed.
ProfileIn.phone has no format/length validation — any arbitrary string is accepted. Consider lightweight E.164 normalization or at least a max_length to avoid storing junk.
Dialog components emit console warnings about missing aria-describedby — accessibility nit for all Radix Dialog usages (SettingsDialog, new chat dialog).
WebSocket on fresh login still closes before established (console warning); REST fallback masks it but worth tracing the mount race.

success_rate.backend: 100% (7/7 new iter4) — overall suite 33/34 (one pre-existing iter3 test obsolete due to new avatar validation)

seed_data_creation: Set Giulia's phone to '+39 333 9998877' then '+39 333 1112222' via UI; uploaded a 1x1 PNG and set as Giulia's avatar. Values persisted — may want to revert if other test suites depend on empty phone/original avatar.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `python -m pytest backend/tests/ -q` from /app. The iter3 test TestGroupInfo::test_admin_updates_name_desc_avatar now fails because server validates group avatars must be /api/files/* URLs (good hardening). Update that test to first POST /api/upload then use the returned URL. Giulia's phone is '+39 333 1112222' and her avatar is set to an uploaded /api/files/ URL after this run.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in iter4 scope.
